title: Add Back navigation across calculator flow tabs to review prior selections

requirements.text: Add a visible Back button/navigation control on every step (“tab”) of the VAT calculator flow so users can return to previous steps to review and adjust previously selected options.

quotes: Amend the App,  add a Back button for all the tabs to check the options selected and changes made to previous tabs

acceptanceCriteria: On /calculator, each step in the multi-step flow (Select Country, Transaction Details, VAT Results, Explanation, Invoice Preview) provides a Back action that returns to the immediately previous step in the flow.
The Back action uses the existing step state so that when returning to a prior step, previously selected/entered values are still shown (no loss of form selections due to navigation).
The Back button label is in English and consistently styled with existing buttons (using the shared Button component).

requirements.text: Implement Back navigation for the calculator flow steps that currently do not expose it to the user, specifically: (1) the initial “Select Country” step and (2) the “Explanation” step, wiring them into the existing step navigation in CalculatorFlowPage.

quotes: add a Back button for all the tabs

acceptanceCriteria: The “Select Country” step UI includes a Back button that returns the user to the previous location (or, if there is no prior step, navigates back to the app home/landing route) without breaking the flow.
The “Explanation” step UI includes both Back and Continue actions: Back returns to “VAT Results”; Continue advances to “Invoice Preview”.
CalculatorFlowPage step transitions remain consistent (i.e., no step skipping, and currentStep updates correctly when using Back/Continue).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn components); compose them instead.
Do not modify immutable frontend hook files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep backend as a single-actor Motoko canister; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Adding new calculation logic or changing VAT category logic.
Adding new routes or replacing the top-level header navigation tabs (Calculator/Invoices/Pricing).
Implementing browser-history-based navigation beyond the in-flow Back buttons.
